h:
这是一个简单的工作流程，取自我以前的一次性工作流程。在做几乎相同的事情的同时，减少不必要的复杂性。我在最后使用了 lut 和皮肤升级剂。

这是您需要的皮肤升级器https://openmodeldb.info/models/1x-SkinContrast-High-SuperUltraCompact.

我无法找到我使用的特定 LUT，但这更多的是个人喜好，你可以在这里找到一堆https://freshluts.com/.

o.en:
This is a simple workflow that takes from my old One-Shot workflow. way less needlessly complex while doing pretty much the same thing. I apply a lut and skin upscaler towards the end.

this is the skin upscaler you will needhttps://openmodeldb.info/models/1x-SkinContrast-High-SuperUltraCompact.

i was unable to find the specific LUT i use, but it's more of a personal preference thing anyway, you can find a bunch herehttps://freshluts.com/.
